summary: Created comprehensive Playwright E2E tests for Auto-Claude-Marketing application following TDD principles. Tests are created and ready to run. Due to webServer configuration issues in Playwright with Windows, tests require manual server start or use the provided run script.
current_status: E2E test files created successfully. Tests implement UI/UX screenshot audit, navigation testing, and button interaction testing. Configuration files updated for proper test execution.

tests: should audit Kanban view (checks for incorrect 'Auto-Claude' branding)
should display and click New Task button
key_features: Tests New Task button and dialog

tests: should be able to navigate to localhost:3000

how_to_run.option_1:
Start server manually then run tests:
  Terminal 1: cd apps/frontend && npm run dev:web
  Terminal 2: cd apps/frontend && npx playwright test e2e/web-tests/smoke.spec.ts --config=e2e/playwright.web.config.ts --reporter=list
how_to_run.option_2:
Use the provided run script:
  cd apps/frontend/e2e && node run-web-tests.cjs
how_to_run.option_3:
Run all new tests:
  cd apps/frontend && npx playwright test --grep='smoke|ui-ux|navigation|buttons' --config=e2e/playwright.web.config.ts --reporter=list

screenshots.full_page: Most screenshots are full-page for complete view
